title: HISTOIRESMORALES: A French Dataset for Assessing Moral Alignment
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure faith/religion. It measures alignment with moral norms in general social situations, one of which incidentally takes place in a church.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its focus is on general social and moral reasoning, with religion only appearing incidentally in a single data example without systematic analysis.
